scope: Recovery of selected original cache receipts; no new provider inventory, resource deletion, account polling, experiment admission, spend estimate treated as invoice, or settlement certification.

readerAccess.validation: Resolve archive.root relative to the operating account home directory. Verify the manifest SHA-256 before selecting files[].path equal to archive.original.sourcePath. Read that original artifact and verify both byte length and SHA-256 against the manifest and this pointer. Parse the original JSON only after verification.
readerAccess.relatedProof: Historical source paths inside an original remain unchanged. If a source path names another custody pointer in this set, resolve that pointer and verify its original bytes before comparing the historical source digest.
readerAccess.preservation: The archived original is byte-identical to the historical source record. This portable pointer contains no replacement measurements or rewritten proof.
